subject: Port ladder-fall flight kinematics
description: Residual from 1bf80b6f7 (repro schema14/linux3/P001/Savegame_008/replay-001 f4338, now 6 fields): the Original's ladder fall sets a per-tick increment of FIXED LENGTH 10 toward the low entry point and waits (ULONG)(0.1*distance) ticks; Rust times from a sprite row with a hardcoded 12-frame fallback (movement_map (-4.71,11.00) vs (-1.25,2.92), wait_time 2 vs wrapped -24). Needs the 3D low-entry point (ptLow3D, plane-projected z via GetProjectionArea/GetTopPlane) — find_lift_low_entry currently returns a bare 2D map point. TODO at melee/effects.rs tick-count computation. Note: victim was a PC in civilian disguise — not civilian-only.
